title.zh: 将东萨马省吉万的Felipe Abrigo纪念工艺学校的名称变更为Felipe Abrigo国立纪念工艺学院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Felipe Abrigo Memorial School of Arts and Trades in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, To Felipe Abrigo National Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Felipe Abrigo Memorial School of Arts and Trades in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, To Felipe Abrigo National Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Felipe Abrigo Memorial School of Arts and Trades in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, thành Felipe Abrigo National Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Felipe Abrigo Memorial School of Arts and Trades in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, เป็น Felipe Abrigo National Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Felipe Abrigo Memorial School of Arts and Trades in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, menjadi Felipe Abrigo National Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Felipe Abrigo Memorial School of Arts and Trades in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, menjadi Felipe Abrigo National Memorial College of Arts and Trades

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7502_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Felipe Abrigo Memorial School of Arts and Trades in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, is hereby changed to Felipe Abrigo Memorial College of Arts and Trades.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
